peers.name: find-animation-opportunities
peers.description: Search a codebase or UI for places that don't animate but should, and reject everything that shouldn't. Read-only; it proposes motion with exact values, it does not implement it. Use when the user asks "what could be animated here?" or wants to "make this feel more alive". For fixing existing animations, use improve-animations or review-animations instead.

peers.name: animate
peers.description: Build an animation from scratch, making the decisions in the order that determines whether it feels right — should it animate at all, what purpose, which tool, which properties, which curve and duration, how it interrupts, how it exits. Writes the implementation. Use when asked to animate something, add motion, make a component feel alive, or build a transition. For critiquing existing motion use review-animations; for auditing a whole codebase use improve-animations.

peers.name: emil-design-eng
peers.description: Emil Kowalski's design-engineering philosophy for UI polish, component design, animation decisions, and the invisible details that make software feel great. Use when building or reviewing a UI component's interactions and polish (press and hover states, popover origin, tooltip timing, transitions vs keyframes, clip-path techniques, drag details) and no narrower skill fits.

peers.name: review-animations
peers.description: Reviews animation and motion code against a high craft bar derived from Emil Kowalski's design engineering philosophy. Default to flagging; approval is earned.

en.tagline: Timing and order for elements that move together
en.summary: Choreograph decides how several animating elements relate: what moves, in what order, how much they overlap, and what stays still. It aims to make a group read as one motion instead of a set of separate animations with their own delays. Easing, duration and origin of a single animation are handled by the animate skill, not this one.
problem: Agents often add a delay to every child in a group, animate a parent's entrance and then stagger its children, and make a view wait for the next one to finish. Each piece looks smooth alone, but the user ends up waiting for the interface to finish before they can act.

With this skill, most moving parts are removed or run in parallel. Sequencing is kept only where order has meaning, such as reading order, cause and effect, or one thing arriving before another. Lists that open often are left without stagger.
fit: A staggered list or a hero entrance with several parts
A view swap inside one container, or a multi-step flow
An item leaving while its siblings close the gap, or an icon with a background and lines that move together
unfit: Tuning the easing, duration or origin of one animation (use animate)
Deciding whether something should animate at all (use find-animation-opportunities or remove-animations)
steps: List every element that moves in response to the event and give each one a role: Lead, Support, Decoration or Static.
For each pair of moving elements, choose whether they run together, overlap, run in sequence, or carry along with a parent.
Hook each secondary effect to the moment of the lead it belongs to, such as its start, impact or settle.
Adjust durations and bounce to the size of the change, and set the values per transition when there are only a few states.
Write a timeline with one row per moving element, then implement it with the lightest tool that fits.
Verify by recording the interaction and stepping through it frame by frame, then run the interruption checks for re-triggering mid-sequence.

zh.tagline: 协调多个同时运动元素的节奏与顺序
zh.summary: Choreograph 决定多个动画元素之间的关系：哪些元素动、按什么顺序动、彼此重叠多少，以及哪些保持不动。它的目标是让一组元素看起来像一个连贯的动作，而不是各自带着延迟的独立动画。单个动画的缓动、时长和起点由 animate 技能处理，不在这里。
problem: 常见做法是给一组中的每个子元素都加上延迟，先做父容器的入场动画再逐个做子元素的错峰入场，或者让一个视图等另一个视图结束后再出现。每段动画单独看都很顺滑，但用户最终要等界面全部播完才能操作。
使用这个技能后，大部分会动的元素会被去掉或改为并行。只有当顺序有意义时才保留先后关系，比如阅读顺序、因果关系，或者某个东西必须先到达。经常打开的列表则不加错峰效果。
fit: 带有多个部分的错峰列表或首屏入场动画
同一容器内的视图切换，或多步骤流程
元素离开时相邻元素填补空缺，或图标、背景和线条一起运动
unfit: 调整单个动画的缓动、时长或起点（请使用 animate）
判断某个元素是否应该有动画（请使用 find-animation-opportunities 或 remove-animations）
steps: 列出响应同一事件而运动的所有元素，并为每个元素指定角色：主角、辅助、装饰或静止。
对每一对运动元素，选择它们是同时运动、部分重叠、按顺序运动，还是跟随父元素一起移动。
把每个辅助效果绑定到它所属的主角动作的关键时刻，例如开始、落点或停止。
根据变化的幅度调整时长和回弹；如果状态不多，就为每次切换单独设定数值。
先写出时间线，每个运动元素占一行，然后用最轻量、够用的工具实现。
录制交互过程并逐帧检查；再测试序列进行中重复触发的情况。
